subject: Logic
title: Availability Heuristic
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Availability Heuristic.

hook.text: Which kills more—shark attacks or falling coconuts? Coconuts win, but your brain says sharks.

buildup.text: The availability heuristic judges probability by how easily examples pop into your mind.

discovery.text: Dramatic events (plane crashes, terrorism) feel common because media covers them endlessly.

twist.text: Heart disease kills far more than homicides, but headlines about murder shape our fear more.

climax.text: To beat this trap, check the actual statistics instead of trusting how vivid a memory feels.

quiz.question: What does the availability heuristic use to judge probability?
options: How easily examples come to mind
